title: Senior Data Scientist - Machine Learning
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years building production ML and data products across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Chooses from a wide range of techniques, from a recommendation reranker and propensity models to anomaly detection and LLM applications, and serves them behind FastAPI with Docker, Kubernetes and MLflow. Guides teams on ML approaches and explains models plainly to product stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Marketplace Recommendation Ranking Service
bullets: Built a two-stage recommender for an online marketplace, retrieving candidate items with SBERT embeddings and re-ranking them with a LightGBM model trained on user browsing and bidding events.
Evaluated ranking quality offline with recall and NDCG, sized the embedding model for serving latency, and ran real-time and batch predictions through FastAPI on Kubernetes with Airflow.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist - Machine Learning role at Catawiki. Over eight years I have moved between model internals and product conversations, building a recommendation reranker, prediction systems and LLM applications that run in production. The thread through my work is picking the right technique for the problem and seeing it through to value.

Almost every item on Catawiki is one of a kind, so recommendations, search and trust cannot lean on popularity alone. That is a harder and more interesting ML problem than most marketplaces offer. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Amsterdam together and settle there long term.

I would bring range and a habit of helping others move faster. At Optum my reranker for a recommendation system raised conversion by 2%, and at Viavi I deployed an SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow that cut downtime by 67%. I also guided client teams through POCs on 15+ engagements.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Working with teachers taught me to test ideas with the people who use them and keep what helps. I would be glad to talk about how I could contribute to the Data Team.
